title.ja: レッドウィンター連邦通信

title.en: Pudding ration raised to two per student, effective immediately

summary.en: The Secretary called it "a historic day for the revolution". The cafeteria called it "a lot of pudding".
summary.ja: 書記長は「革命にとって歴史的な日」と述べ、食堂は「プリンが多すぎる」と述べた。

title.ja: 今週末、今季初雪の予報

summary.en: Students are reminded that snowball fights in the corridors still count as unauthorised gatherings.
summary.ja: 廊下での雪合戦は、引き続き無許可の集会とみなされますのでご注意を。
